proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9883 markaṭa² explicitly gives Hindi makṛī, Punjabi makkaṛī, Nepali mākuro and Oriya makaṛā “spider”. The survey k-r/ḍ spider variants fit the documented family; its relation to other insect-name reconstructions remains qualified. Uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages does not prevent this supported family link under the user’s preference.
